hero_h1: Ungal bill counter, ungal porutkal, ungal computer-il.
hero_sub: Karots POS mulusa unga sontha computer-la run aagudhu — ore oru file, maathaandha kattanam illa, internet thevaiyum illa. Kadan kodukkira, stock & kaalavathi paakkira, suppliers manage panra kadaigalaekkaga pannadhu — verum bill adikkirathukku mattum illa.
hero_demo_cap: ↑ Original mini counter — porulgalai thodunga, cash vangunga, bill adiyunga.
pos1_p: File, database, bill ellam ungakittathaan. Subscription ninnu ponaalum ethum cut aagathu.
pos2_p: Kadan kanakku, split payment, supplier accounts, cash tally ellam main software-laye varudhu; thaniya kaasu katti vangura add-on kidaiyaathu.
pos3_p: Unga kadaikku thevaiyana features mattum vachu software ready panni tharuvom. Unga kadai peyarayum brand panni kuduthuduvom.
product_lead: 9 mukkiyana vasathigal, entha extra plugin-um illama main software-laye irukku.
try_caption: Idhula siladhai neenga ingayE try pannalaam:
plugins_h: Kadaikku etha mathiri prathyegama ready panrathu!
plugins_lead: Ovvoru plugin-um unga kadai software-laye sethu build pannapadum. Appothaikkunnu thaniya ethum install aagathu; unga kadaikku thevaiyillatha entha vishayamum athula irukkathu.
deploy_h: Unga computer-la ore oru thadava setup panna pothum!
pricing_h: Entha murayila use panna poringanu neengale therndheduga!
pricing_lead: Offline options-ku orey thadava vilai, online-ku chinna maasa kattanam. Vilai Ilangai rooba-la, thorayamaana dollar vilaiyoda.
demo_lead: Nijamaana billing, reports, plugins — install pannaama paarunga.
hire_h: Unga kadaikku etha mathiri prathyegama ethavathu senju tharanuma?
hire_lead: Naan Sheik Adhnan — POS modifications, plugins, mobile apps mathiri unga thevaigalukku thakkatha mathiri thanippatta murayila senju tharuven.
foot_tag: Self-hosted point of sale. Unga kadai, unga data.

pnote_2: Mudhal maasathukku appuram, support ovvoru call-kkum kattanam — vElai evvalavu perusunnu poruthu vilai.
